subject.title: Cron jobs stall during AI model calls (model_call:stream_progress never completes)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for the cron wake mode now result-contract gap, or should maintainers split Bug 3 into a new focused issue now that the stream-progress stall is fixed on main?
rationale: The code gap is source-visible, but the durable product contract needs a choice between fire-and-forget enqueue semantics and awaitable wake-result semantics across the gateway RPC and agent cron tool.

options.title: Keep this issue scoped to wake result semantics
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker for Bug 3 and define how cron.wake should report queued, completed, and failed wake attempts.

options.title: Split Bug 3 into a new focused issue
options.body: Close or retitle this bundled report only after a narrower cron wake contract issue exists and links back to the original evidence.

options.title: Accept fire-and-forget wake semantics
options.body: Document that cron.wake success only means the event was queued, and require separate diagnostics for later heartbeat failure.

recommendation.title: Keep this issue scoped to wake result semantics
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker for Bug 3 and define how cron.wake should report queued, completed, and failed wake attempts.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus authored the landed run-lifecycle stack and the latest issue comment that explicitly scoped the remaining Bug 3 decision.
